   329	| Readiness row | Offer | One per check (tier; storage or consent; store approval when pending): state in words plus an icon, never color alone; what is missing ("Needs 1.4 GB more space") and its next step. "Buy" enables only when all are ready and asks for the PIN first (FR-63) |

Removing the model needs no PIN: it deletes no child data (FR-71) `[ASSUMPTION]` |

Report note: 280 characters, counter, warning not to include personal details. Email fields carry the email autofill type (1.3.5) |

item.text:
Place the answers side by side, with the declining option (“No” or “Not now”) on the left and first in keyboard focus order; when space or large text requires stacking, put it on top. Give both the same size, tonal style and visual weight—never a filled approval button beside a text-only refusal. Use neutral wording without guilt, loss framing or urgency, and preselect only the more private option where a standing choice needs a default.
